'''College 1975 FC''' is an [[association football]] team from [[Gibraltar]]. Originally formed in 1975, they currently play in the [[Gibraltar Football League]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.gibraltarfa.com/competitions/second-division-18-19-967826|title=Gibraltar Football Association|website=Gibraltar Football Association}}</ref>"}}
